findings.title_en: Flying welding sparks with no visible screen
Body and respiratory protection cannot be fully confirmed
Visible welding fumes with no visible ventilation

summary_en: There are four low-severity findings in total, with no high- or medium-severity findings. The most urgent item is to verify on site the adequacy of welding-fume ventilation and fire-prevention measures. Nothing in the frames requires work to stop, provided the specified on-site checks are completed before the next welding operations.
